label: animated mini-series
summary: Anime-style mini-series: limited animation, held poses, strong angles, stylised compositions.
source: Maestro guideline from limited-animation conventions; not measured on a corpus.

rhythm.note: held poses carry the time; impact comes from the cut, not from motion

camera: held compositions with small secondary motion (hair, cloth, blinks, drifting light); slow pans across a still composition; a quick push-in for impact; no handheld
look: stylised and graphic: clean line art, cel shading, strong rim light, saturated sky gradients, light shafts; one colour script per scene
acting: expressive but posed: clear key poses held for the beat, eyes and mouth carry the emotion; no continuous full-body acting
motifs: low-angle hero shot against the sky; silhouette at a decision
extreme close-up on the eyes for a resolve
wind in hair and cloth for a held beat; strong diagonals and split compositions for conflict
do: stronger angles than live action (low, high, overhead) and bold negative space
establish each place with a wide background plate
dont: no smear frames, impact frames or speed lines: AI video morphs them; get impact from a cut, a held pose and a stronger angle
no long full-body choreography or fast fights in one shot
